-- Final result - clean output
WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as min_date,
           MAX(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           min_date,
           max_date,
           (min_date + INTERVAL (gs.day_offset) DAY) as cal_date
    FROM date_range
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(0, DATEDIFF('day', CAST(min_date AS DATE), CAST(max_date AS DATE))) as gs(day_offset)
),
daily_txns AS (
    SELECT customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
           CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount
                WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                ELSE 0 END as net_change
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_balances_raw AS (
    SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.cal_date,
           COALESCE(SUM(dt.net_change), 0) as daily_change
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN daily_txns dt ON ad.customer_id = dt.customer_id AND ad.cal_date = dt.txn_date
    GROUP BY ad.customer_id, ad.cal_date
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date, daily_change,
           SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date) as running_balance
    FROM daily_balances_raw
),
adjusted_balances AS (
    SELECT customer_id, cal_date,
           GREATEST(running_balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM cumulative_balances
),
customer_monthly_max AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date) as month,
           customer_id,
           MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM adjusted_balances
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date), customer_id
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', month) as month,
       SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM customer_monthly_max
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', month)
ORDER BY month
